saints.name: Paul the Hermit
saints.legacy: The first hermit and model of solitude
saints.summary: Saint Paul the Hermit is recognized as the first hermit and is known for his life of solitude in the Egyptian desert. After fleeing persecution, he lived for nearly ninety years in prayer and penance, relying solely on God's providence for sustenance. His legacy is closely tied to Saint Anthony, who discovered him and shared in his spiritual life before Paul's death.

saints.name: Maurus
saints.legacy: Model of humility and monastic dedication
saints.summary: Saint Maurus was a Benedictine abbot known for his deep humility and miraculous abilities. He was a disciple of Saint Benedict and played a significant role in the establishment of monastic life in France, founding the abbey of Glanfeuil. His legacy includes a strong devotion among the faithful and a lasting influence on monastic practices in the region.
